title: Mortality rate attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (exposure to unsafe Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for All (WASH) services)
national_indicator_available: Mortality rate attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (exposure to unsafe Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for All (WASH) services)
national_indicator_description: Timeseries data are currently unavailable for this indicator. However, a point estimate of 25 deaths per 100,000 population in 2019 is provided on the World Health Organization (WHO) [Data Portal](https://data.who.int/indicators/i/C123B15/ED50112?m49=646). Breakdowns by sex are also available from the same portal, with 28.7 male deaths and 21.5 female deaths per 100,000 population in 2019.
indicator_definition: The mortality rate attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (exposure to unsafe Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for All (WASH) services) as defined as the number of deaths from unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (exposure to unsafe WASH services) in a year, divided by the population, and multiplied by 100,000.
